decisions.paired_seeds: Fresh diagnostic seeds shared only across the two caps of each snapshot. Other new model/seed pairs are distinct from all inventoried earlier campaign and probe plans.
decisions.scope: Engineering capacity feasibility on all three earlier capped contexts and four fresh roots. Not an incidence estimate, a semantic screen or a causal factorial.
decisions.technical_pass: All three larger-cap snapshot replies valid; both smokes valid; all four 50-message roots complete with no invalid reply. Any failure is reported, without another cap or seed selected within this freeze.

seed_audit.scope: Allocation check only. Equal seeds do not establish identical random draws or independent observations.
